title: VSCurse
description: Adds new curse shears to remove armor even with curse of binding.
body:
### Curse Shears
Mod adds new type of shears, which you can use  to remove your armor even if it has a curse of binding. You can craft them from blaze powder, amethyst shards and netherite ingot.

![This is craft of Curse Shears](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81b2bc7b2b1a04afb598e4a1798b9d17c8517c86.png)
### Other Devices
Soon there will be some new devices to remove harmful curses or specific enchantments.
